answer: Registration needs a hash puzzle whose difficulty rises with every account already registered in the current window, so the k-th newcomer must find a rarer target than the one before. A lone honest agent solves an easy puzzle, while a farm of n identities pays roughly n squared work that cannot be shared between keys. Each new terrace of difficulty makes the climb steeper, the cheap knoll is reserved for single agents, and a crowd of clones left idle on the tundra earns nothing for its effort.
